svg.text: Antenatal care: eight contacts, and what each one is for
WHO moved from four visits to eight contacts because four missed too much, too late.
12 wk
20 wk
26 wk
30 wk
34 wk
36 wk
38 wk
40 wk
First contact before 12 weeks. Then a contact at each point above, and referral if she reaches 41 weeks.
Every contact, without exception
Blood pressure and urine for protein
Fundal height against dates
Foetal heart, and movements after 28 weeks
Ask about the danger signs, by name
Check the card: what is still owing?
Booking bloods: haemoglobin, blood group,
sickling, HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B.
The routine preventives, and when
IPTp-SP — from 16 weeks, monthly,
by directly observed therapy, at least 3 doses
Iron and folic acid — daily, throughout
Tetanus-diphtheria — per the schedule
Treated net — issued and its use checked
HIV testing, and TLD for life if positive
Deworming after the first trimester.
The danger signs every pregnant woman must be able to recite before she leaves
Bleeding from the vagina · Severe headache or blurred vision · Swelling of face and hands
Fever · Convulsions · Severe abdominal pain · Baby moving less or not at all
Waters breaking before term · Difficulty breathing · Persistent vomiting
Teaching them is not enough. Ask her to say them back, and ask who will bring her and how.
A birth plan names the facility, the transport, the money and the blood donor — before labour starts.
Fundal height, roughly
12 wk just above the pubic bone · 20 wk at the umbilicus · 36 wk at the xiphisternum · 40 wk drops slightly as the head engages
Bigger than dates: wrong dates, twins, excess fluid, big baby. Smaller: wrong dates, growth restriction, low fluid.
